speaker_role: current admissions officer (Columbia Undergraduate Admissions), official office video
commercial_incentive: None evident beyond the office recruiting applicants.
key_insights: Applicants apply to Columbia College or Columbia Engineering without choosing a major, and both are reviewed by full-time staff in much the same way.
Review is holistic with no test or GPA cutoffs and contextual, judging achievement within each applicant's own circumstances rather than against the pool.
Required materials include transcript, school report and counselor recommendation, two teacher letters, and SAT or ACT, with optional creative portfolio or research abstract.
The essay should address the chosen prompt, be redrafted, proofread and reviewed by several people; ordinary topics are fine and a true voice matters.
The transcript is read for good grades in a relatively challenging curriculum, alongside the school report and counselor letter.
Choose teacher recommenders from later in high school to show how you'd contribute in class.
The writing supplement (lists of books, media, news, community) mirrors Columbia's values; research the school, reflect on fit, and use simple comma lists without commentary.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Early decision deadline Nov 1 (binding) and regular decision Jan 1 for first-year applicants, per the officer.
Three application routes: Common App, Coalition, and QuestBridge for finalists.
notable_or_distinctive: Official statement that Columbia requires SAT/ACT and explicit description of the supplement's purpose and list format.
reliability_notes: Official but promotional and about a year old; testing requirement and deadlines may have changed, and captions show 'Colombia' misspellings.
